items.headline: CENTCOM: Iran ki zameeni supply par rok
items.detail: America ki Central Command ne Task Force Iron Gate banayi hai jo Iran ki zameeni seemaon aur Caspian Sea se hathiyaron aur pratibandhit saaman ki aavaajahi rokegi.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav me nakabandi ka vistaar — Hormuz aur samudri vyapar ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Israel: Eisenkot ko sarkar banane ka mauka
items.detail: Rashtrapati Isaac Herzog ne Netanyahu ke pratidvandi Gadi Eisenkot ko sarkar banane ka mauka diya; 67 sansadon ne unka samarthan kiya, Netanyahu ko 46 mile, aur Eisenkot ke paas 28 din hain.
items.exam_angle: Israel me sarkar gathan aur Knesset ki bhoomika — Madhya Purv ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Ronen Horesh / Knesset Archives, CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Qeshm-Jask: Hormuz kinare phir dhamake
items.detail: Iran ke sarkari media ke anusar Qeshm dweep aur Jask, Sirik aur Bandar Abbas me dhamakon ki awaazein suni gayin; wajah abhi saaf nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg aur America-Iran tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha aur urja ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Sanaa: Hawai hamle me 27 ki maut
items.detail: Sanaa ke paas al-Shariya gaon par hawai hamle me Houthi-run health ministry ke anusar kam se kam 27 ki maut aur 36 ghayal hue; Houthis ne Saudi Arabia par aarop lagaya, Riyadh ne abhi koi tippani nahi ki.
items.exam_angle: Yemen grih yuddh aur Saudi-Houthi sangharsh — Madhya Purv ki suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump: Democrats ki jaanch ka aadesh
items.detail: Trump ne Justice Department ko Democrats ki jaanch ka aadesh diya, aarop hai ki ve mahaabhiyog ki dhamki dekar 'dabaav' bana rahe hain; unhone koi saboot nahi diya.
items.exam_angle: America me midterm ke baad satta santulan aur Congress ki nigrani — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
